fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 47% match is a WEAK FIT for this Senior Search Algorithms role at Elastic.

**Strengths:**
- Java and Kotlin experience, including the Spring Boot settlement service you designed and ran
- PostgreSQL and Redis work, including moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis
- Open-source bug fixes to a Kotlin library, plus code review and GitHub Actions CI

**Gaps:**
- No search or vector database experience (Elasticsearch, Solr)
- No HNSW, IVF or search algorithm work at scale
- No MongoDB or Cassandra exposure

**Recommendation:** Build a small Elasticsearch project and contribute to its open-source codebase before applying, so your Java depth is backed by search evidence.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Search Relevance team needs engineers who can keep fast, scalable software readable while it grows. At Lumen Payments, I cut the p99 latency of our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis. That meant understanding why the storage layer behaved as it did before deciding how to change it.

I haven't worked on search or vector databases, so I won't pretend otherwise. What I bring is 11 years of building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python, with PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka underneath. I designed and ran the settlement service, then led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith, so owning a project from technical design to delivery is familiar ground. Code review and API design are part of how I work, and I've contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, which taught me to work with maintainers I'd never met. Your distributed, GitHub-based way of working, with code review on every change, is how I want to build software. I would bring the same care to Lucene-level problems in Elasticsearch, and I learn the unfamiliar parts of a codebase quickly.

I'd welcome a conversation about where I could contribute to the vector search work, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Elastic Hiring Team,

Your team needs strong core Java and a solid grasp of how data storage works, and I've spent 11 years building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python. That includes cutting latency on a payment status API by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis, and designing and running a settlement service from start to finish. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm free for a call on any weekday, Toronto time.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

followUpEmail.body:
Dear Elastic Hiring Team,

Kind regards,
